commit.message:
Allow fork PR checkout in Enhance workflow (#7263)

GitHub now refuses fork checkouts under pull_request_target unless
allow-unsafe-pr-checkout is set. This hotfix is so that Enhance can still read fork PR files as data while scripts run from the trusted base.

Co-authored-by: Tomoya Fujita <fujita.tomoya@triorb.co.jp>

commit.message:
Run the Enhance workflow only for pull requests targeting rolling (#7267)

pull_request_target workflows are evaluated from the default branch, so
the workflow added in #6981 also runs for backport pull requests against
the distro branches (e.g. #7252, #7266). Those branches do not have the
ensure-enhancements Makefile target, so the catch-all rule fails with
"No module named sphinx" and the check is red.

Restrict the trigger to the rolling base branch, which is what #6981
intended.

Co-authored-by: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
